description:
Goal
Make Enum.reduce/2 and Enum.reduce/3 work over a Map. Today both panic during native lowering.

Current signal
On a non-empty map %{2 => :two, 1 => :one}:
- `Enum.reduce(map, 0, fn ({k, _v}, acc) -> acc + k end)` (reduce/3 over Map)
- `Enum.reduce(map, fn ({k, _v}, {ak, av}) -> {ak + k, av} end)` (reduce/2 over Map)
both fail with:
  error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]: native attempted to materialize absent value as runtime value with ty Some(Ty(19)) in Clause { owner: ExecutableKey { activation: ActivationKey { root: RootId(0), function: FunctionId(65), arrow: Ty(33|34) }, need: Value }, index: 0 }
  thread panicked at src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs:2826

Both land in the same function (65 — a Map Enumerable reduce path) materializing the same absent Ty(19). Interp also reported Enum.EmptyError for reduce/2 over a non-empty map, suggesting the Map reduce path loses the element/accumulator value before native lowering.

Root analysis (to confirm)
The Map Enumerable reduce callback path drops a value (element or accumulator) so native sees an absent value where a runtime value is required. Likely a transport/representation gap specific to the Map impl's reduce, related to the shared reduce-bridge capture-flow correlation (fz-f98 / fz-bfh.1 family) but Map-specific. Note Enum.map/Enum.to_list over a Map work, so it is the reduce path specifically.

Required work
- Reproduce with minimal reduce/2 and reduce/3 over Map fixtures, pinned interp + run + build.
- Trace the absent Ty(19) value to its dropped producer in the Map reduce path and restore it through transport without special-casing.
- Confirm reduce_while/3 over Map (tracked separately in fz-bfh.2 as a multi-surface boundary error) is considered together if the root overlaps.

Checks
- New reduce/2 and reduce/3 over Map regressions green on all three paths.
- map_enumerable / range_enumerable matrices remain green.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.
title: Enum.reduce/2 and reduce/3 over a Map materialize an absent value (native.rs:2826)
